facts.text: `handleRunningWorkInput` detects Down/Up with `matchesKey(data, "down")` and `matchesKey(data, "up")` from Pi TUI rather than comparing raw byte sequences, so Pi-normalized keys such as CSI `1;1B` are recognized. Opening the browser on Down also requires an empty editor text.

`green-chat-input` wraps the editor returned by `ctx.ui.getEditorComponent()` instead of replacing it, so the `SwarmPromptEditor` installed by `swarm-themes` (which handles running-work input) stays active. `package.json` lists `extensions/swarm-themes/index.ts` before `extensions/green-chat-input/index.ts`.

Running-work state (items, listeners, expanded, selected, sessionId) lives on `globalThis[Symbol.for("pi-swarm-running-work")]` via `state()` in `running-work-store.ts`. `scopeRunningWorkToSession` in `running-work.ts` keeps items across a reload of the same session and clears them when the session ID changes.
The ask-user tool, pending-ask resume, and answer-command flows all call the shared `runAskFlow` controller, which opens the UI via `ctx.ui.custom`.
